BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r1.claim: The Prophet's mention was elevated by joining his name to God's in the testimony of faith and calls to prayer, making obedience to him obedience to God, blessing him through God and angels, and commanding believers to bless him.
BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r1.anchor: رفع حيث قرن اسمه باسم الله في كلمة الشهادة والأذان والإقامة

BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r2.speaker: حسان بن ثابت
BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r2.claim: Hassan ibn Thabit's poem says God placed a seal of prophethood on Muhammad and joined the Prophet's name to His own in the five daily calls to prayer.
BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r2.anchor: اغر عليه للنبوة خاتم من الله مشهور يلوح ويشهد

BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r3.speaker: ذو النون المصري
BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r3.claim: Dhu al-Nun says the Prophet's raised mention means the aspirations of other prophets circled the Throne, while his own aspiration soared beyond them.
BURSEVI:v10p356#3/r3.anchor: همم انبيا عليهم اسلام بر حوالىء عرش جولان مي نمودند وطاهر همت آن حضرت عليه السلام رواز ميكرد

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r1.claim: Sūrah Alam Nashraḥ completes the preceding sūrah: 93:6’s sheltering and other favours concerned the period before and just after prophethood, while this sūrah points to blessings after Islam spread in Arabia.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r1.anchor: It begins after Sūrah al-Ḍuḥā without any prior introduction

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r2.claim: The prior sūrah predicts a bright future; this one points to predictions already beginning to materialize and assures the Prophet that hardship yields to success if faced courageously.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r2.anchor: by making a reference to some such predictions which by then had shown clear signs to materialize, an emphatic assurance is sounded to the Prophet

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r3.claim: The discourse proceeds from inner expansion, through the recurring law of hardship with relief, to completion of the mission and disciplined use of its success.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r3.anchor: Initially a reference is made to the gift of

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p365/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p365/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p365/r3.claim: Raising the Prophet’s voice means his once-weak call had become a reverberating roar; “for you alone” emphasizes God’s exclusive support.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p365/r3.anchor: This verse simply comforts the Prophet (sws) by asserting

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p366/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p366/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p366/r2.claim: The verse indicates a stage when Islam had spread through pilgrims at ḥajj, especially the Anṣār, and beyond Arabia, making the call impossible to silence.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p366/r2.anchor: pilgrims who came to Ka‘bah became a constant

QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r12.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r12.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r12.claim: God raised the Prophet's mention by joining it to His own: the testimony is not valid without mention of both.
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r12.anchor: فكما لا تصح كلمة الشهادة إلا بي ، فإنها لا تصح إلا بك

QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r13.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r13.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r13.claim: Another interpretation is that God raised the Prophet's mention through people's saying, “Muhammad is God's Messenger.”
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r13.anchor: ويقال : رفعنا لك ذكرك بقول الناس : محمد رسول الله

QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r14.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r14.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r14.claim: Another interpretation is that God established the honor of the Prophet's messengership.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r5.claim: God raised the Prophet's renown by pairing his name with God's in the testimony, calls to prayer, tashahhud, sermons, Qur'an, earlier scriptures, and the covenant of earlier prophets and peoples.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r5.anchor: هو أن قرنه بذكره تعالى في كلمة الشهادة والأذان والإقامة والتشهد

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r6.speaker: حسان
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r6.claim: Ḥassān's poem witnesses that the Prophet's name was joined to God's in the five daily calls to prayer.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r6.anchor: وضم الإله اسم النبي إلى اسمه ... إذا قال في الخمس المؤذن أشهد

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r7.claim: The enumerated favors imply victory over enemies; the promise of ease also counters unbelievers' mockery of the believers' poverty and assures prompt relief after hardship.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p500/r7.anchor: وتعديد هذه النعم عليه صلى الله عليه وسلم يقتضي أنه تعالى كما أحسن إليك بهذه المراتب،

FARRA:v3p275#2/r3.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p275#2/r3.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p275#2/r3.claim: Muḥammad's remembrance is mentioned whenever God is mentioned.

BAYDAWI-FULL:94:4-6/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:94:4-6/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:94:4-6/r1.claim: God elevated the Prophet through prophethood and other honors: pairing his name with God’s in the testimony, equating obedience, angelic and believer prayers, and honorific address; لك creates suspense before clarification.
BAYDAWI-FULL:94:4-6/r1.anchor: { ورفعنا لك ذكرك } بالنبوة وغيرها، وأي رفع مثل أن قرن اسمه باسمه تعالى

BINTSHATI:v1p68/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p68/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p68/r1.claim: The word dhikr gains majesty from its association with God and from its established use for revelation; God's raising Muhammad's mention thus gives the fullest reassurance and honor.
BINTSHATI:v1p68/r1.anchor: وهذا مما يضفى على كلمة الذكر جلالاً ورفعه، لكبرة ما تفترن بذات الجلالة

BINTSHATI:v1p68/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p68/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p68/r2.claim: The author declines to specify exactly how the Prophet's mention was raised: being chosen as messenger already exceeds every worldly ambition for an orphan from a poor family.
BINTSHATI:v1p68/r2.anchor: فحسب محمد أن اصطفاه الله رسولاً، ليكون له من هذا الاصطفاء ما يجاوز كل مطمح

BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r1.claim: God raised the Prophet’s remembrance through his virtues, prophethood, migration, and the pairing of his name with God’s in testimony, call to prayer, prayer, and sermons.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r1.anchor: في كلمة التوحيد والإيمان والإذان والإقامة والتشهد والخطبة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r2.speaker: الرازي
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r2.claim: Al-Rāzī’s account continues by saying that the Prophet’s community received an abundant share of this honor.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r2.anchor: قال الرازي : ثم جعل لأمته من ذلك أوفر الحظ

BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r3.speaker: النبي
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r3.claim: Asked who God’s friends are, the Prophet answered that they are those whose mention brings God to mind.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r3.anchor: قيل : يا رسول الله , من أولياء الله ؟ قال : ( الذين إذا ذكروا ذكر الله )

BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r4.speaker: النبي
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r4.claim: A related report describes God’s friends as people whose sight reminds others of God.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r4.anchor: وفي حديث : ( الذين إذا رؤوا ذكر الله )

BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r5.speaker: النبي
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r5.claim: The best people are those whose appearance recalls God, speech increases knowledge, and actions inspire detachment from worldly life.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r5.anchor: وقال : ( خياركم من تذكر الله رؤيته , ويزيد في علمكم منطقه

BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r6.claim: The highest praise is to have the Prophet’s remembrance joined with God’s remembrance.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p462/r6.anchor: فمنتهى قسمة الثناء أن خلط ذكره بذكره

NAHHAS:v5p252/r1.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p252/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
NAHHAS:v5p252/r1.claim: In a report from Abū Saʿīd, Gabriel relays God's question about how the Prophet's renown was raised; the Prophet replies that God knows, and God answers, ‘When you are mentioned with Me.’
NAHHAS:v5p252/r1.anchor: في الحديث المسند عن أبي سعيد الخدري عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال قال لي جبرئيل صلى الله عليه وسلم إن ربي وربك عز وجل يقول لك كيف رفعت ذكرك قال قلت الله أعلم قال إذا ذكرت معي

DURR-FULL:v8p549/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p549/r1.speaker: عدي بن ثابت عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p549/r1.claim: God reminded the Prophet of being sheltered as an orphan, guided, enriched, given an expanded breast, relieved of his burden, and exalted in mention; God is mentioned alongside him and took him as a friend.
DURR-FULL:v8p549/r1.anchor: وأخرج ابن أبي حاتم عن عدي بن ثابت

DURR-FULL:v8p549/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p549/r2.speaker: أنس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p549/r2.claim: The Prophet asked what honor he received beyond earlier prophets; God said He joined his mention with God's, made his community's hearts bear scripture, and gave him the throne's treasure ‘no power or strength except by God.’
DURR-FULL:v8p549/r2.anchor: وأخرج أبو نعيم في الدلائل عن أنس

DURR-FULL:v8p549/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p549/r3.speaker: ابن عباس عن أبي صالح
DURR-FULL:v8p549/r3.claim: He said God is never mentioned without the Prophet being mentioned alongside Him.
DURR-FULL:v8p549/r3.anchor: وأخرج ابن عساكر من طريق الكلبي عن أبي صالح عن ابن عباس

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r2.claim: God raised the Prophet's name and spread it throughout the earth while he was still in Mecca.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r2.anchor: وقوله تعالى: ورفعنا لك ذكرك معناه، نوهنا باسمك، وذهبنا به كل مذهب في الأرض،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r3.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري والحسن ومجاهد وقتادة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r3.claim: These authorities say God joined the Prophet's name to His own in the call to prayer and sermons.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r3.anchor: وقال أبو سعيد الخدري والحسن ومجاهد وقتادة: معنى قوله ورفعنا لك ذكرك أي قرنا اسمك باسمنا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r4.claim: A report says God told the Prophet, when you are mentioned, I am mentioned with you.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r4.anchor: وروي في هذا الحديث «إن الله تعالى قال: إذا ذكرت معي» .

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r5.claim: Because the call to prayer began in Medina, Ibn Atiyya sees this interpretation as fitting an early Meccan revelation only if understood as a future blessing.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r5.anchor: وهذا متجه إلى أن الآية نزلت بمكة قديما. والأذان شرع بالمدينة،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r6.claim: Fame benefits those responsible for people, while anonymity can benefit those devoted to worship; God apportions blessings to individual needs.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r6.anchor: ورفع الذكر نعمة على الرسول، وكذلك هو جميل حسن للقائمين بأمور الناس،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r7.claim: A report depicts God reminding a servant of blessings, including raising his mention among people.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r8.claim: The reminder comforts Muhammad against Quraysh: the giver of these blessings will grant victory over them.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r8.anchor: فلا تكترث بأذى قريش، فإن الذي فعل بك هذه النعم سيظفرك بهم وينصرك عليهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas and Mujahid say God raised the Prophet's mention by including it in the call to prayer; Hassan ibn Thabit's poetry witnesses that his name follows God's in the five daily testimonies.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r1.anchor: وحكى البغوي، عن ابن عباس ومجاهد: أن المراد بذلك: الأذان. يعني: ذكره فيه، وأورد من شعر حسان بن ثابت:

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r2.speaker: آخرون
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r2.claim: Other commentators say God elevated the Prophet's mention among earlier and later peoples, secured the prophets' pledge to believe in him and instruct their communities, and joined his name with God's in his community.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r2.anchor: وقال آخرون: رفع الله ذكره في الأولين والآخرين، ونوه به،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r3.speaker: الصرصري
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r3.claim: Al-Sarsari's poetry says the obligatory call to prayer is not valid without the Prophet's honored name and its repetition.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p431/r3.anchor: لا يصح الأذان في الفرض إلا … باسمه العذب في الفم المرضي

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r13.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r13.speaker: يحيى بن سلام
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r13.claim: Yahya ibn Sallam says the Prophet's name was raised through prophethood.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r13.anchor: أحدها : ورفعنا لك ذكرك بالنبوة , قاله يحيى بن سلام .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r14.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r14.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r14.claim: Another view says his name was raised in the afterlife as it was in this world.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r14.anchor: ورفعنا لك ذكرك في الآخرة كما رفعناه في الدنيا

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r15.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r15.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r15.claim: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reports that Gabriel told the Prophet God says that whenever He is mentioned, the Prophet is mentioned too.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r15.anchor: روى أبو سعيد الخدري عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال : ( أتاني جبريل عليه السلام فقال : إن الله تعالى يقول أتدري كيف رفعت ذكرك

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r16.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r16.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r16.claim: Qatada says the Prophet's name was raised in this world and the next, with the testimony to his messengership joined to God's oneness in sermons and prayers.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p296#2/r16.anchor: قاله قتادة : رفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والآخرة , فليس خطيب يخطب ولا يتشهد

MUQATIL:94:2-8/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:94:2-8/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:94:2-8/r2.claim: God raised Muhammad's name among people so that whenever God is mentioned, the Messenger is mentioned too, including in marriage sermons.
MUQATIL:94:2-8/r2.anchor: { ورفعنا لك ذكرك } [آية: 4] في الناس علما، كلما ذكر الله تعالى ذكر معه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

ZAJJAJ:v5p341/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p341/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p341/r3.claim: God raised the Prophet’s renown by joining it with the declaration of His oneness in the call to prayer and other frequent remembrances.
ZAJJAJ:v5p341/r3.anchor: جعل ذكر رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - مقرونا بذكر توحيد الله في الأذان

RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r1.claim: God's raising of Muhammad's renown includes fame on earth and in heaven, his name on the Throne and alongside God's name in testimony, prayer, and scripture.

RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r2.claim: His renown spreads through sermons, calls to prayer, letters, Qur'an, and earlier scriptures; God calls him Messenger or Prophet while naming Moses and Jesus directly.

RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r3.claim: God makes people love mentioning Muhammad, praise him, pray for him, and preserve his Sunna; each ritual prayer joins an obligatory act to his practice.
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r3.anchor: وأيضا جعله في القلوب بحيث يستطيبون ذكره

RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r4.claim: Obeying and pledging allegiance to Muhammad count as obeying and pledging allegiance to God.

RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p6#2/r5.claim: His honor endures through readers, exegetes, preachers, scholars, rulers, and people seeking his intercession and blessing at his resting place.

STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r1.speaker: most commentators
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r1.claim: Most call al-Sharḥ Makkan and place it just after Sūrah 93; Ibn ʿAbbās calls it Madinan, while some assign only vv. 5–6 to Madinah.
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r1.anchor: considered by most commentators to be a Makkan sūrah, most likely revealed immediately after the preceding one. Ibn ʿAbbās is reported to have said that it is Madinan

STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r3.claim: Some say Sūrahs 93 and 94 were originally one, since Companions recited them together in one prayer cycle without a basmalah separating them.
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r3.anchor: the Companions of the Prophet would recite them together in a single prayer cycle

STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r5.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r5.claim: Both sūrahs present God's bounties as relief: Sūrah 93 addresses external needs, Sūrah 94 spiritual relief; 94 recalls blessings, reassures, then commands exertion and turning to God.
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r5.anchor: Thematically both sūrahs speak of the bounties that God has provided the Prophet Muhammad as relief for the difficulties that beset him

ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r1.claim: Ash-Sharh was revealed almost immediately after Ad-Duha and appears to continue it directly.
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r1.anchor: revealed almost immediately af ter the preceding one, appears to be a direct continuation of the latter

ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r2.speaker: Ta'us ibn Kaysan and Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r2.claim: They regarded Ad-Duha and Ash-Sharh as one surah and recited them in prayer without a second basmala; Asad cites Razi.
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r2.anchor: Ta'us ibn Kaysan, or the Caliph Umar i bn Abd al-Aziz (known as "the Second Umar") - regarded Ad-Duha and Ash-Sharh as one surah

ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r3.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r3.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r3.claim: The surah addresses the Prophet first and, through him, every true follower of the Qur'an.
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r3.anchor: addressed in the first instance to the Prophet and, through him, to every true follower of the Qur'an

TABATABAI:94:2-5/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:94:2-5/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:94:2-5/r5.claim: God raised the Prophet's mention above others, pairing his name with God's in the two testimonies and requiring every Muslim to mention him in each of the five daily prayers; the lift follows the burden poetically.
TABATABAI:94:2-5/r5.anchor: ومن رفع ذكره أن قرن الله اسمه صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم باسمه

TABATABAI:94:1-8/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:94:1-8/r2.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
TABATABAI:94:1-8/r2.claim: Jibril tells the Prophet that God raised his mention by ensuring that whenever God is mentioned, the Prophet is mentioned with Him.
TABATABAI:94:1-8/r2.anchor: أخرج أبو يعلى وابن جرير وابن المنذر وابن أبي حاتم وابن حبان وابن مردويه وأبو نعيم في الدلائل عن أبي سعيد الخدري

TABRISI:94:4-6/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:4-6/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:94:4-6/r1.claim: God joined Muhammad's name to His own so that he is mentioned with God in the call to prayer, testimony, and sermons.
TABRISI:94:4-6/r1.anchor: أي قرنا ذكرك بذكرنا حتى لا أذكر إلا وتذكر معي يعني في الأذان والإقامة

TABRISI:94:4-6/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:4-6/r2.speaker: قتادة
TABRISI:94:4-6/r2.claim: God raised Muhammad's mention in both this world and the next; prayer leaders and witnesses repeatedly testify to his messengership.
TABRISI:94:4-6/r2.anchor: قال قتادة: رفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والآخرة فليس خطيب ولا متشهد ولا صاحب صلاة

TABRISI:94:4-6/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:4-6/r3.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري
TABRISI:94:4-6/r3.claim: A Prophetic report from Abu Saʿid says Gabriel conveyed God's statement: whenever God is mentioned, Muhammad is mentioned with Him.
TABRISI:94:4-6/r3.anchor: وفي الحديث عن أبي سعيد الخدري عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في هذه الآية

TABRISI:94:4-6/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:4-6/r4.speaker: حسان بن ثابت
TABRISI:94:4-6/r4.claim: Hassan's poems praise God for joining Muhammad's name to His and giving him a prophetic seal.
TABRISI:94:4-6/r4.anchor: حسان بن ثابت يمدح النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم:

THALABI:v10p232#3/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p232#3/r9.speaker: النبي
THALABI:v10p232#3/r9.claim: Asked by the Prophet about raising his mention, Gabriel conveyed God’s saying that whenever God is mentioned, the Prophet is mentioned with Him.
THALABI:v10p232#3/r9.anchor: عن أبي سعيد الخدري، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه سأل جبرائيل عن هذه الآية

THALABI:v10p232#3/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p232#3/r10.speaker: الحسن
THALABI:v10p232#3/r10.claim: He says the Prophet’s mention is joined to God’s: when God is mentioned, Muhammad is mentioned with Him.
THALABI:v10p232#3/r10.anchor: عن الحسن في قوله ورفعنا لك ذكرك، قال: إذا ذكرت ذكرت معي

THALABI:v10p232#3/r11.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p232#3/r11.speaker: قتادة
THALABI:v10p232#3/r11.claim: God raises Muhammad’s mention in this world and the next, since sermons, witness statements, and prayers all proclaim his messengership alongside God’s oneness.
THALABI:v10p232#3/r11.anchor: وقال قتادة: يرفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والآخرة، فليس خطيب ولا متشهد ولا صاحب صلاة

THALABI:v10p232#3/r12.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p232#3/r12.speaker: مجاهد
THALABI:v10p232#3/r12.claim: He says the Prophet’s mention is raised through the call to prayer.

THALABI:v10p232#3/r13.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p232#3/r13.speaker: حسان بن ثابت
THALABI:v10p232#3/r13.claim: His poem praises the prophetic seal from God as renowned, shining, and witnessed, illustrating the Prophet’s raised mention.
THALABI:v10p232#3/r13.anchor: يقول حسان بن ثابت يمدح النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: أغر عليه للنبوة خاتم … من الله مشهور

THALABI:v10p233/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p233/r1.speaker: حسان بن ثابت
THALABI:v10p233/r1.claim: The continuation of Hassan’s poem says the Prophet’s name is joined to God’s name in the five daily calls to witness.
THALABI:v10p233/r1.anchor: وضم الإله اسم النبي الى اسمه … إذا قال في الخمس المؤذن أشهد

THALABI:v10p233/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p233/r2.speaker: ابن عطاء
THALABI:v10p233/r2.claim: He interprets the raised mention as God making remembrance of Muhammad complete faith in Him.
THALABI:v10p233/r2.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء: يعني جعلت تمام الإيمان بي بذكرك

THALABI:v10p233/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p233/r3.speaker: قيل
THALABI:v10p233/r3.claim: Another view is that God raised the Prophet’s mention among the angels in heaven.
THALABI:v10p233/r3.anchor: وقيل: ورفعنا لك ذكرك عند الملائكة في السماء

THALABI:v10p233/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p233/r4.speaker: قيل
THALABI:v10p233/r4.claim: Another view connects the raised mention to God’s covenant with the prophets, requiring them to believe in Muhammad and acknowledge his merit.
THALABI:v10p233/r4.anchor: بأخذ ميثاقه على النبيين وإلزامهم الإيمان به والإقرار بفضله

THALABI:v10p233/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p233/r5.speaker: ذو النون
THALABI:v10p233/r5.claim: He says the prophets’ aspirations circle the Throne while Muhammad’s is above it, explaining the uniquely exalted mention.
THALABI:v10p233/r5.anchor: همم الأنبياء تجول حول العرش وهمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم فوق العرش

THALABI:v10p233/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p233/r6.speaker: ذو النون
THALABI:v10p233/r6.claim: He adds that creatures will seek Muhammad’s intercession on Judgment Day because they know his standing with God.
THALABI:v10p233/r6.anchor: ومفزع الخلق يوم القيامة إلى محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم كمفزعهم إلى الله

THALABI:v10p234/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p234/r4.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p234/r4.claim: The first verses recount God’s favors, while the prefixed fa in the first ease clause links it as a promise of immediate worldly relief and wealth.
THALABI:v10p234/r4.anchor: فهذا ذكر امتنانه عليه، ثم ابتدأ ما وعده من الغنى

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:94:1-6/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:94:1-6/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:94:1-6/r3.claim: God raised Muhammad's mention so that he is mentioned whenever God is mentioned.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:94:1-6/r3.anchor: { ورفعنا لك ذكرك } أي: إذا ذكرت ذكرت معي.

BURSEVI:v10p356#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p356#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p356#2/r6.claim: God raised the Prophet's mention by granting him the title and rulings of prophethood.

QASHANI:94:1/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:94:1/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:94:1/r4.claim: Opening also raises the Prophet’s mention: the annihilated one in pure unity would otherwise have no existence or name, and Islam would be incomplete without both declarations, that there is no god but God and Muhammad is God’s messenger.
QASHANI:94:1/r4.anchor: وذلك هو شرح الصدر وهو بعينه وضع الوزر المذكور ورفع الذكر لأن الفاني في الجمع لا يكون شيئا فضلا عن أن يكون مذكورا

SULAMI:v2p404#3/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p404#3/r1.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p404#3/r1.claim: Faith in God is completed by mentioning the Prophet alongside Him; calling Muhammad Messenger entails calling God Lord.
SULAMI:v2p404#3/r1.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : جعلت تمام الإيمان بي بذكرك معي قال : لا يذكرك أحد بالرسالة

SULAMI:v2p404#3/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p404#3/r2.speaker: ذو النون
SULAMI:v2p404#3/r2.claim: Prophets' aspirations circle the Throne, while Muhammad's surpasses it; his elevated standing makes him the creation's refuge on Judgment Day.
SULAMI:v2p404#3/r2.anchor: وقال ذو النون رحمه الله : همم الأنبياء تحول حول العرش ، وهمة محمد

SULAMI:v2p404#3/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p404#3/r3.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p404#3/r3.claim: God made the Prophet's remembrance part of His own remembrance, so remembering him is like remembering God.
SULAMI:v2p404#3/r3.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : جعلتك ذكرا من ذكري فكأن من ذكرك ذكرني

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3443#2/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3443#2/r2.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3443#2/r2.claim: The Prophet recounts God's answer to his request for prophetic miracles: God reminded him of shelter as an orphan, guidance, enrichment, opening his chest, removing his burden, and raising his remembrance.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3443#2/r2.anchor: عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال : ' سالت ربي مسالة وددت اني لم اكن سالته

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445/r1.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445/r1.claim: The Prophet says that after he asked about miracles granted earlier prophets, God reminded him He had sheltered him as an orphan, guided and enriched him, opened his chest, and raised his remembrance.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445/r1.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير ، عن ابن عباس قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : ' سالت ربي مسالة وددت اني لم اكن سالته

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r1.speaker: مجاهد
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r1.claim: Mujahid says Muhammad is never remembered without being mentioned alongside God in the testimony of faith.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله : ورفعنا لك ذكرك قال : لا اذكر الا ذكرت معي اشهد ان لا اله الا الله

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r2.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r2.claim: Qatada says God raised Muhammad's remembrance in this world and the next: every preacher, witness to faith, and person praying proclaims the testimony.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r2.anchor: عن قتادة ورفعنا لك ذكرك قال : رفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والاخرة ، فليس خطيب ولا متشهد ولا صاحب صلاة

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r3.speaker: جبريل
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r3.claim: Gabriel tells the Prophet that whenever God is mentioned, Muhammad is mentioned with Him.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r3.anchor: عن أبي سعيد الخدري عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال : ' اتاني جبريل فقال : ان ربك يقول : تدري كيف رفعت ذكرك

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r4.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r4.claim: A report says God answered Muhammad's comparison with Abraham and Moses by recalling his own blessings, including raised remembrance, and saying that He had chosen him as a close friend.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3445#3/r4.anchor: عن عدي بن ثابت قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : ' سالت ربي مسالة اني لم اكن سالته

TUSTARI:94:4/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:94:4/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:94:4/r1.claim: God joined the Prophet's name to His in the call to prayer and declaration of unity, so a servant's faith is incomplete without belief in him.
TUSTARI:94:4/r1.anchor: قال: وصلنا اسمك باسمنا في الأذان والتوحيد، فلا يقبل إيمان العبد حتى يؤمن بك.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r2.claim: Raising the Prophet's mention is a metaphor for causing people to remember him well by creating the means of his reputation; he was known for exceptional virtues and called al-Amin.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r2.anchor: ورفع الذكر مجاز في إلهام الناس لأن يذكروه بخير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r3.claim: His name's pairing with God's name in the profession of faith is a supreme instance of raised mention; Qur'an 81:19–21 may also refer to Muhammad.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r3.anchor: ومن عظيم رفع ذكره أن اسمه مقترن باسم الله تعالى في كلمة الإسلام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r4.claim: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri transmits a Prophetic interpretation of raised mention; al-Suyuti grades its Ibn Hibban and Abu Ya'la chain fair, while Qadi Iyad cites it without a chain.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r4.anchor: وروي هذا التفسير عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في حديث أبي سعيد الخدري عند ابن حبان وأبي يعلى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r5.claim: The addition of لك with 'raised' parallels 'expanded for you'; عنك with 'removed your burden' also signals care while supplying the needed complement and a vague-then-specific effect.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p412/r5.anchor: والقول في ذكر كلمة { لك } مع { ورفعنا } كالقول في ذكر نظيرها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r1.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r1.claim: A report from the Prophet says God told Gabriel that whenever God is mentioned, Muhammad is mentioned with Him; Qatada notes that the testimony is spoken in sermons, prayers and other public worship.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r1.anchor: ما روى أبو سعيد الخدري عن رسول صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه سأل جبريل عن هذه الآية

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r2.speaker: يحيى بن سلام
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r2.claim: One interpretation is that God raised the Prophet's remembrance through prophethood.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r2.anchor: رفعنا لك ذكرك بالنبوة قاله يحيى بن سلام

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r3.speaker: الماوردي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r3.claim: Another view is that God raised the Prophet's remembrance in the afterlife as He raised it in this world.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r3.anchor: رفعنا لك ذكرك في الآخرة كما رفعناه في الدنيا حكاه الماوردي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r4.speaker: الثعلبي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r4.claim: A further view is that God raised the Prophet's remembrance among the angels in heaven.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r4.anchor: رفعنا لك ذكرك عند الملائكة في السماء

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r5.speaker: الثعلبي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r5.claim: God also raised his remembrance by binding the prophets through a covenant to believe in him and acknowledge his virtue.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p163#2/r5.anchor: بأخذ الميثاق لك على الأنبياء وإلزامهم الإيمان بك والإقرار بفضلك حكاهما الثعلبي

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r3.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r3.claim: Mujahid says Muhammad is never mentioned without being mentioned alongside God, as in the paired testimonies of faith.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r3.anchor: قال مجاهد: لا أذكر إلا ذكرت معي: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله، وأشهد أن محمدا رسول الله.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r4.speaker: قتادة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r4.claim: Qatada says God raised Muhammad's remembrance in this world and the next: every preacher, witness, and person praying proclaims his testimony alongside God's oneness.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r4.anchor: وقال قتادة: رفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والآخرة، فليس خطيب ولا متشهد ولا صاحب صلاة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r5.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r5.claim: In a report from Abu Sa'id, Gabriel tells the Prophet that God raises his remembrance because whenever God is mentioned, Muhammad is mentioned with Him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r5.anchor: عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال: "أتاني جبريل فقال: إن ربي وربك يقول: كيف رفعت ذكرك؟

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r6.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas reports the Prophet recounting God's reminders that He sheltered him as an orphan, guided him, enriched him, expanded his chest, and raised his remembrance; he affirms each gift.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "سألت ربي مسألة وددت أني لم أكن سألته

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r7.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r7.claim: In an Anas report, God gives the Prophet the distinction that He is never mentioned without the Prophet being mentioned, alongside Qur'an-reading hearts and a treasure from the Throne.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p430/r7.anchor: عن الزهري، عن أنس قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "لما فرغت مما أمرني الله به من أمر السموات والأرض

JISHUMI:v10p7465/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7465/r8.speaker: الحسن ومجاهد وقتادة
JISHUMI:v10p7465/r8.claim: God raised the Prophet's remembrance by ensuring that His name is not mentioned without the Prophet's, as in the testimony of faith; Abū Saʿīd reports this from the Prophet.
JISHUMI:v10p7465/r8.anchor: قيل: بأني لا أذكر إلا ذكرت، كقولهم: لا إله إلا الله محمد رسول الله، عن الحسن، ومجاهد، وقتادة،

JISHUMI:v10p7465/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7465/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7465/r9.claim: Other views say his remembrance was raised by making him the last prophet, by joining his name to faith in God, or by honoring him among angels and believers.
JISHUMI:v10p7465/r9.anchor: وقيل: رفعنا لك ذكرك بأن جعلناك خاتم الأنبياء، ورفع الذكر هو عظم القدر،

JISHUMI:v10p7465/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7465/r10.speaker: أبو علي
JISHUMI:v10p7465/r10.claim: Abū ʿAlī says his name is elevated among believers on earth and angels in heaven; other views mention the prophetic covenant or his being creation's refuge in intercession.
JISHUMI:v10p7465/r10.anchor: وقيل: رفع ذكره عند المؤمنين في الأرض، وعند الملائكة في السماء، عن أبي علي.

KASHSHAF:94:4/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:4/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:94:4/r1.claim: God raised Muhammad's mention by pairing it with His in the testimony of faith, calls to prayer, prayer formulas, sermons, Qur'anic verses, his titles, earlier scriptures, and the covenant requiring prophets and their peoples to believe in him.
KASHSHAF:94:4/r1.anchor: أن قرن بذكر الله في كلمة الشهادة والأذان والإقامة والتشهد والخطب

KASHSHAF:94:4/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:4/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:94:4/r2.claim: The added laka creates a suspenseful allusion then clarification: first what was expanded is left implicit before the breast is named, and similarly with your mention and burden.
KASHSHAF:94:4/r2.anchor: في زيادة لك ما في طريقة الإبهام والإيضاح ،   كأنه قيل

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p775#2/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p775#2/r8.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p775#2/r8.claim: God raised the Prophet's remembrance through testimony, calls to prayer, ritual, sermons, Qur'anic pairings, his titles, earlier scriptures, and prophetic covenants.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p775#2/r8.anchor: ورفع ذكره : أن قرن بذكر الله في كلمة الشهادة والأذان

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p775#2/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p775#2/r9.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p775#2/r9.claim: Adding “for you” first leaves the object implicit and then clarifies chest or remembrance, a rhetorical pattern also used with the burden.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p775#2/r9.anchor: في زيادة لك ما في طريقة الإبهام والإيضاح

NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#4/r1.claim: The Prophet's remembrance is elevated by pairing it with God's name in the testimony, call and start of prayer, sermons, tashahhud, Qur'anic commands, and titles such as Messenger of God.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#4/r1.anchor: ورفع ذكره ان قرن بذكر الله فى كلمة الشهادة والآذان والاقامة والخطب والتشهد

NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#4/r2.claim: The wording first leaves the expanded object implicit and then clarifies it—“your chest,” “your remembrance,” “your burden”—a rhetorical pattern of ambiguity followed by clarification.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#4/r2.anchor: وفائدة ذلك ما عرف فى طريقة الابهام والايضاح لأنه يفهم بقوله ألم نشرح لك أن ثم مشروحا

QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r1.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r1.claim: Mujahid interprets the raising of the Prophet's mention as its inclusion in the call to prayer.

QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r2.speaker: حسان بن ثابت
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r2.claim: Hassan ibn Thabit's poem says God joined the Prophet's name with His own in the testimony proclaimed by the caller to prayer.

QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r3.claim: Al-Dahhak transmits Ibn Abbas's view that the Prophet is mentioned with God in the adhan, iqama, tashahhud, sermons, festivals, pilgrimage rites, and marriage sermon; denying his messengerhood nullifies a person's worship and makes him an unbeliever.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r3.anchor: وروي عن الضحاك عن ابن عباس، قال: يقول له لا ذكرت إلا ذكرت معي

QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r4.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r4.claim: Another view says God raised the Prophet's name in earlier revealed books, commanded previous prophets to announce him, and made his religion prevail over every religion.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r4.anchor: وقيل: أي أعلينا ذكرك، فذكرناك في الكتب المنزلة على الأنبياء قبلك،

QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r5.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r5.claim: A further view says the Prophet is honored among angels in heaven and believers on earth, and will be raised in the afterlife through the Praised Station and noble ranks.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:4/r5.anchor: وقيل: رفعنا ذكرك عند الملائكة في السماء، وفي الأرض عند المؤمنين،

QUTB-ZILAL:94:4/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:94:4/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:94:4/r1.claim: God raised Muhammad's name in heaven, on earth, and throughout existence, uniquely joining it with God's name in the testimony of faith; no higher rank follows this.
QUTB-ZILAL:94:4/r1.anchor: رفعناه فجعلنا اسمك مقرونا باسم الله كلما تحركت به الشفاه

QUTB-ZILAL:94:4/r2.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:94:4/r2.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:94:4/r2.claim: Across generations, millions invoke Muhammad's noble name with blessings, salutation, and deep love; even being chosen for the divine method elevated him beyond all others.
QUTB-ZILAL:94:4/r2.anchor: حين قدر الله أن تمر القرون ، وتكر الأجيال ، وملايين الشفاه في كل مكان تهتف بهذا الأسم الكريم

RAZI:94:4/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:4/r1.speaker: author
RAZI:94:4/r1.claim: The verse encompasses all ways the Prophet’s renown was raised: prophethood, fame in heaven and earth, his name on the Throne, paired mention in testimony and earlier scriptures, and being the final prophet.
RAZI:94:4/r1.anchor: من النبوة ، وشهرته في الأرض والسموات ، اسمه مكتوب على العرش

RAZI:94:4/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:4/r2.speaker: author
RAZI:94:4/r2.claim: His name is raised in sermons, the call to prayer, letters, and their openings and endings; Qurʾanic commands repeatedly pair obedience to God with obedience to His Messenger.
RAZI:94:4/r2.anchor: وأنه يذكر في الخطب والأذان ومفاتيح الرسائل

RAZI:94:4/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:4/r3.speaker: author
RAZI:94:4/r3.claim: God made people love mentioning the Prophet and promised affection for believers; the world is filled with followers who praise him, invoke blessings, and preserve his Sunnah.
RAZI:94:4/r3.anchor: وأيضا جعله في القلوب بحيث يستطيبون ذكره

RAZI:94:4/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:4/r4.speaker: author
RAZI:94:4/r4.claim: God made the Prophet’s obedience equivalent to His own and his pledge equivalent to a pledge to God, as the cited verses state.

RAZI:94:4/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:4/r5.speaker: author
RAZI:94:4/r5.claim: Even rulers follow the Prophet; reciters preserve his words, exegetes explain the Qurʾān, preachers convey his counsel, and scholars and rulers seek his service and intercession.
RAZI:94:4/r5.anchor: فالقراء يحفظون ألفاظ منشورك ، والمفسرون يفسرون معاني فرقانك

RAZI:94:4/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:4/r6.speaker: author
RAZI:94:4/r6.claim: His honor remains until the Resurrection, as people greet him, touch the soil of his resting place, and hope for his intercession.
RAZI:94:4/r6.anchor: ويرجون شفاعتك ، فشرفك باق إلى يوم القيامة

STUDYQURAN:94:4/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:4/r1.speaker: some commentators
STUDYQURAN:94:4/r1.claim: The Prophet's renown rose through the title Messenger of God and its inclusion with God's Name in the testimony of faith, call to prayer, and prayer's closing greeting.
STUDYQURAN:94:4/r1.anchor: a title connected with the Name of God

STUDYQURAN:94:4/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:4/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:94:4/r2.claim: The strongest sign of Muhammad's renown is God's and the angels' blessing on him, which believers are commanded to invoke.
STUDYQURAN:94:4/r2.anchor: The strongest indicator of the Prophet’s great renown is in 33:56

STUDYQURAN:94:4/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:4/r3.speaker: some
STUDYQURAN:94:4/r3.claim: Some identify the elevated renown with blessings upon the Prophet; others with his mention in earlier scriptures.
STUDYQURAN:94:4/r3.anchor: According to some it is such blessings to which v. 4 refers

TAB-FULL:v24p495/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r1.claim: God elevated the Prophet's remembrance so he is named alongside God in the testimony that there is no god but God and Muḥammad is His messenger.
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد، {ورفعنا لك ذكرك} [الشرح: 4] قال: لا أذكر إلا ذكرت معي: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله

TAB-FULL:v24p495/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r2.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r2.claim: Mujāhid gives the same explanation: whenever God is remembered, Muḥammad is remembered with Him in the testimony.
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد، {ورفعنا لك ذكرك} [الشرح: 4] قال: لا أذكر إلا ذكرت معي: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله

TAB-FULL:v24p495/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r3.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r3.claim: Qatāda says God raised the Prophet's remembrance in this life and the next, so speakers of sermons, testimony, and prayer invoke him.
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r3.anchor: عن قتادة، {ورفعنا لك ذكرك} [الشرح: 4] رفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والآخرة، فليس خطيب، ولا متشهد، ولا صاحب صلاة

TAB-FULL:v24p495/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r4.claim: A report from the Prophet says Gabriel relayed God's question about how Muḥammad's remembrance was raised; whenever God is mentioned, he is mentioned too.
TAB-FULL:v24p495/r4.anchor: عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، أنه قال: " أتاني جبريل فقال: إن ربي وربك يقول: كيف رفعت لك ذكرك؟

ASAD-NOTES:94:1#n3/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:94:1#n3/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:94:1#n3/r1.claim: Dhikr primarily means reminder or remembrance, secondarily what makes someone remembered with praise, and here figuratively denotes eminence or dignity.
ASAD-NOTES:94:1#n3/r1.anchor: The primary meaning of the term dhikr is "reminder" or "remembrance"

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r1.speaker: جماعة المفسرين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r1.claim: The Prophet's renown is so raised that God is not mentioned without him also being mentioned.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r1.anchor: قال جماعة المفسرين: لا ذكرت، إلا ذكرت معي (¬5).

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r2.claim: In ʿAṭāʾ's report, Muḥammad's name accompanies God's in the call to prayer, testimony, sermons, festivals, pilgrimage rites, marriage, public spaces, and currency; affirming God without his messengership would not benefit a worshipper.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r2.anchor: وشرح ذلك ابن عباس فيما روى (عنه) (¬6) عطاء، فقال: يريد الأذان، والإقامة، والتشهد

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r3.speaker: حسان بن ثابت
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r3.claim: Ḥassān's poem points to the muezzin joining the Prophet's name to God's name in the five daily calls.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p128#2/r3.anchor: وإلى هذا أشار حسان بن # ثابت في قوله:

WAHIDI-QT:94:4/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:94:4/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:94:4/r1.claim: God raised Muhammad's mention so that whenever God is mentioned, Muhammad is mentioned with Him.
WAHIDI-QT:94:4/r1.anchor: { ورفعنا لك ذكرك } أي إذا ذكرت ذكرت معي

ELMALILI:94:4/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:4/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:4/r1.claim: The repeated fronting of laka before remembrance says the Prophet's renown is for his benefit, unlike fame that becomes a calamity for its possessor.
ELMALILI:94:4/r1.anchor: Birtakımlarına verilen ve netice itibariyle haklarında âfet olan şöhretler gibi aleyhe değil sırf lehine olarak yükselttik mânası ifade edilmek için

ELMALILI:94:4/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:4/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:4/r2.claim: Here remembrance means honor and renown, while also hinting at the Qur'an and thought, as in 21:10.
ELMALILI:94:4/r2.anchor: şeref ü şân mânasınadır. Bununla beraber Kur’an ve fikir mânasına

ELMALILI:94:4/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:4/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:4/r3.claim: The Prophet's rank among the messengers is elevated, and the summary is that his name follows God's: whenever God is named, he is named too, as in 2:253.
ELMALILI:94:4/r3.anchor: mazmûnu üzere bütün enbiyâ ve rusül içinde derecât ile yüksekliğidir ki, bunun hulâsası

ELMALILI:94:4/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:4/r4.speaker: Resûlullah
ELMALILI:94:4/r4.claim: Elmalılı cites Abu Saʿid al-Khudri's report that God told the Prophet, through Gabriel, that whenever God is mentioned the Prophet is mentioned with Him.
ELMALILI:94:4/r4.anchor: Ebû Sa‘îd-i Hudrî radıyallâhu anh’tan tahric ettikleri üzere Resûlullah buyurmuştur ki:

ELMALILI:94:4/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:4/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:4/r5.claim: The paired testimony of faith and commands to obey God and the Messenger show this shared remembrance, with 4:59, 4:80, and 48:28–29 as evidence.
ELMALILI:94:4/r5.anchor: Allah denilince Resûlü beraber anılır, لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ الله denilince beraberinde مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ الله denilir

ELMALILI:94:4/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:4/r6.speaker: Hassân
ELMALILI:94:4/r6.claim: Hassan's poem says God joined the Prophet's name to His own, and the muezzin bears witness to this at the five prayers.
ELMALILI:94:4/r6.anchor: Hazret-i Hassân’ın şu beyti de bu yüksekliğe işarettir: أَغَرُّ عَلَيْهِ لِلنُّبُوَّةِ خَا تَمٌ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَشْهُودٌ

ELMALILI:94:4/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:4/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:4/r7.claim: The command for believers to bless and greet the Prophet is another sign of his elevated remembrance, in 33:56.
ELMALILI:94:4/r7.anchor: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ صَلُّوا۟ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا۟ تَسْلِيمًا

CORPUSCORANICUM:94:4:anmerkung/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:94:4:anmerkung/r1.speaker: Neuwirth
CORPUSCORANICUM:94:4:anmerkung/r1.claim: Neuwirth compares the verse with Psalm 145:14, where the Lord supports the fallen and raises the bowed down.
CORPUSCORANICUM:94:4:anmerkung/r1.anchor: Neuwirth verweist wiederum auf eine psalmische Parallele, nämlich Psalm 145:14

CORPUSCORANICUM:94:4:anmerkung/r2.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:94:4:anmerkung/r2.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:94:4:anmerkung/r2.claim: The note leaves open whether the verse means the addressee’s worldly standing or status before God.
CORPUSCORANICUM:94:4:anmerkung/r2.anchor: s. auch ebd. zur Frage, ob der vorliegende Vers eher das innerweltliche Ansehen des Angesprochenen oder seinen Status vor Gott meint

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:1/r7.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:1/r7.speaker: Müfessirler
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:1/r7.claim: Exegetes illustrate the Prophet's exalted renown through his mention in sacred books, his name alongside God's in the testimony of faith, reverence from angels and believers, and commands pairing obedience to him with obedience to God.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:1/r7.anchor: kelime-i şehâdette onun isminin Allah’ın ismiyle birlikte yer almasını

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:1/r8.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:1/r8.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:1/r8.claim: Being sent as a mercy to all worlds also expresses his exalted renown; the early verse may promise that his name and religion will later spread worldwide.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:1/r8.anchor: ileride Resûlullah’ın isminin ve tebliğ ettiği dinin bütün dünyada tanınıp yayılacağını bildiren bir müjde

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r1.speaker: النبي
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r1.claim: A Prophetic explanation says mention of him begins with servanthood and follows with messengership.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله تعالى ﴿ ورفعنا لك ذكرك ﴾ أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال بدءا بالعبودية

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r2.speaker: مجاهد
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r2.claim: Mujāhid says the Prophet is mentioned with the testimony that none is god but God and that Muhammad is God's messenger.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r2.anchor: عن ابن نجيح عن مجاهد في قوله تعالى ﴿ ورفعنا لك ذكرك ﴾ قال لا أذكر إلا ذكرت معي

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r3.speaker: النبي
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r3.claim: The Prophet forbids excessive praise like the Christians' praise of Jesus and instructs people to call him God's servant and messenger.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p380#2/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس عن عمر ابن الخطاب أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال لا تطروني كما أطرت النصارى

ALUSI-FULL:v30p165/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p165/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p165/r7.claim: A report about the Night Journey has God remind Muhammad that He sheltered, guided, enriched him, expanded his chest, removed his burden, and raised his mention, demonstrating the surahs' thematic connection.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p165/r7.anchor: يا محمد ألم أجدك يتيما فآويت وضالا فهديت وعائلا فأغنيت وشرحت لك صدرك

ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r1.claim: God raised Muhammad's mention through prophethood, pairing his name with God's in the testimony, pairing obedience with God's, blessing him and commanding believers to do so, addressing him by honored titles, mentioning him in earlier books, and taking covenants from earlier prophets and peoples to believe in him.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r1.anchor: بالنبوة وغيرها وأي رفع مثل أن قرن اسمه عليه الصلاة والسلام باسمه عز وجل في كلمتي الشهادة

ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r2.speaker: مجاهد، قتادة، محمد بن كعب، الضحاك، الحسن
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r2.claim: These authorities explain the raised mention as meaning that whenever God is mentioned, Muhammad is mentioned with Him.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r2.anchor: روي عن مجاهد وقتادة ومحمد بن كعب والضحاك والحسن وغيرهم أنهم قالوا في ذلك لا أذكر إلا ذكرت معي

ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r3.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r3.claim: A Prophetic report from Abu Said says Gabriel told the Prophet that God raised his mention by ensuring that whenever He is mentioned, Muhammad is mentioned too.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r3.anchor: إن ربك يقول أتدري كيف رفعت ذكرك قلت الله تعالى أعلم

ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r4.speaker: حسان بن ثابت
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r4.claim: Hassan ibn Thabit's poem celebrates the seal of prophethood and the joining of the Prophet's name to God's in the call to prayer as evidence of his honored mention.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r4.anchor: وضم الإله اسم النبي إلى اسمه إذا قال في الخمس المؤذن أشهد

ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r5.claim: The verse may focus on the greatest instance of raised mention; placing it after the burden's removal and fronting لك continue the rhetorical pattern explained earlier.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p169/r5.anchor: وكان ذلك من الأقتصار على ما هو أعظم قدرا من أفراد رفع الذكر

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r7.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r7.claim: A report says the Prophet asked Gabriel about the verse, and Gabriel conveyed God's promise: whenever He is mentioned, the Prophet is mentioned with Him.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r7.anchor: عن أبي سعيد الخدري عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه سأل جبريل عليه السلام عن هذه الآية

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r8.speaker: الحسن
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r8.claim: When the Prophet is mentioned, he is mentioned alongside God.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r8.anchor: وعن الحسن قال: "ورفعنا لك ذكرك" إذا ذكرت، ذكرت [معي] (1)

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r9.claim: His mention is raised through the call to prayer, its second call, the testimony in prayer, and sermons from pulpits; denying his messengership invalidates worship and constitutes unbelief.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r9.anchor: وقال عطاء عن ابن عباس: يريد الأذان والإقامة والتشهد والخطبة على المنابر

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r10.speaker: قتادة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r10.claim: God raised the Prophet's name in this life and the next: preachers, witnesses, and worshippers proclaim the testimony that Muhammad is God's Messenger.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r10.anchor: وقال قتادة: رفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والآخرة، فليس خطيب ولا متشهد ولا صاحب صلاة إلا ينادي

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r11.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r11.speaker: الضحاك
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r11.claim: He says prayer is not accepted without the Prophet's name and a sermon is not valid without him.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r11.anchor: وقال الضحاك: لا تقبل صلاة [إلا به

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r12.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r12.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r12.claim: He interprets the raising of the Prophet's mention as occurring through the call to prayer.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p463#2/r12.anchor: وقال مجاهد: [ورفعنا لك ذكرك] (4) يعني بالتأذين.

BINTSHATI:v1p62/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r2.speaker: مفسرون
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r2.claim: Some call the addressed prepositional phrases unnecessary additions, saying they clarify an initially vague object.
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r2.anchor: وقيل في {لِكِ} هنا، إنها زيادة يستقل المعنى بدونها!!

BINTSHATI:v1p62/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r3.claim: That proposed clarification would require stopping before لك, but readers unanimously connect the phrase; صدرَك already identifies what was opened, as the following objects do.
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r3.anchor: ولا نعلم أحداً من القراء قرأها بالوقف، بل الإجماع على قراءتها وصلاً

BINTSHATI:v1p62/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r4.speaker: النيسابوري
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r4.claim: Al-Nishaburi describes لك as an insertion and lists possible functions such as generality followed by specification, exclusivity, or emphasis.
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r4.anchor: الإجمال ثم التفصيل، وإرادة الاختصاص، أو كونه أهم

BINTSHATI:v1p62/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r5.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r5.claim: The ordinary Arabic construction needs no extra theory: fronted prepositional phrases naturally strengthen emphasis, exclusive address, and connection.
BINTSHATI:v1p62/r5.anchor: وإنما للتقرير وتأكيد الاختصاص وتقوية الإيصال

BINTSHATI:v1p63/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p63/r1.speaker: الشيخ محمد عبده
BINTSHATI:v1p63/r1.claim: Abduh says fronting لك, عنك, and لك before their objects adds emphasis and brings the good news quickly.

BINTSHATI:v1p63/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p63/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p63/r2.claim: Ordinary Arabic expressions show that these pronouns are purposeful rather than redundant.
BINTSHATI:v1p63/r2.anchor: وإنما هي ضرورة بيانية اقتضاها المقام

BINTSHATI:v1p67/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r1.speaker: الراغب
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r1.claim: Al-Raghib says remembrance can occur in the heart or on the tongue, through recalling something forgotten or maintaining it in memory.
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r1.anchor: الذكر ذكران: ذكر بالقلب، وذكر باللسان.

BINTSHATI:v1p67/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r2.speaker: الطبري
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r2.claim: Al-Tabari explains the raised remembrance as God's name being recalled whenever Muhammad is recalled; Qatada says this holds in both worlds and in prayer and testimony.
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r2.anchor: فليس خطيب ولا متشهد ولا صاحب صلاة إلا ينادى بها: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله

BINTSHATI:v1p67/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r3.claim: Al-Zamakhshari specifies the Prophet's name paired with God's in the testimony, call to prayer, iqama, tashahhud, sermons, Quranic phrasing, and earlier scriptures' covenant.
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r3.anchor: قرن ذكر الرسول بذكر الله في كلمة الشهادة، والأذان، والإقامة، والتشهد، والخطب

BINTSHATI:v1p67/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r4.speaker: الشيخ محمد عبده
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r4.claim: Abduh emphasizes that Muhammad rescued many nations from superstition and corrupt ideas and restored them to sound human nature.
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r4.anchor: أن الله هداه إلى إنقاذ أمم كثيرة من رق الأوهام وفساد الأحلام

BINTSHATI:v1p67/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r5.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r5.claim: These explanations are complementary and can be gathered under the transmitted interpretation that God raised the Prophet's remembrance.
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r5.anchor: يمكن أن ترد جميعاً إلى ما رواه "الطبري" من أقوال أهل التأويل.

BINTSHATI:v1p67/r6.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r6.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r6.claim: The author notes that dhikr is often attached to God's name or pronoun, while the definite form al-dhikr denotes revelation or the Quran.
BINTSHATI:v1p67/r6.anchor: وجاء الذكر معرفاً بأل، بمعنى الوحي أو القرآن الكريم

DURR-FULL:v8p543/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p543/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p543/r7.claim: When the Prophet compared himself with earlier prophets' miracles, God reminded him of shelter, guidance, enrichment, an opened breast, removal of burden, and raised renown.
DURR-FULL:v8p543/r7.anchor: عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: سألت ربي مسألة ووددت أني لم أكن سألته

DURR-FULL:v8p547/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p547/r6.speaker: الحسن
DURR-FULL:v8p547/r6.claim: He says the Prophet's breast was filled with forbearance and knowledge, his burden was heavy, and his renown is raised whenever he is mentioned.
DURR-FULL:v8p547/r6.anchor: عن الحسن {ألم نشرح لك صدرك} قال: مليء حلما وعلما

DURR-FULL:v8p548/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r5.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r5.claim: The Prophet's renown is raised because God's name is never mentioned without Muhammad being named with it in the testimony of faith.
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r5.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله: {ورفعنا لك ذكرك} قال: لا أذكر إلا ذكرت معي أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله

DURR-FULL:v8p548/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r6.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r6.claim: His name is raised in this world and the next: preachers, witnesses, and worshippers pair Muhammad's testimony with God's.
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r6.anchor: عن قتادة {ورفعنا لك ذكرك} قال: رفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والأخرة فليس خطيب ولا متشهد

DURR-FULL:v8p548/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r7.speaker: محمد بن كعب
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r7.claim: He says Muhammad is named alongside God in the testimony of faith.
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r7.anchor: عن محمد بن كعب في الآية قال: إذا ذكر الله ذكر معه أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله

DURR-FULL:v8p548/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r8.speaker: الضحاك
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r8.claim: He says Muhammad is paired with God in mention and must also be mentioned in sermons and marriage ceremonies.
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r8.anchor: عن الضحاك {ورفعنا لك ذكرك} قال: إذا ذكرت ذكرت معي ولا تجوز خطبة ولا نكاح

DURR-FULL:v8p548/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r9.speaker: الحسن
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r9.claim: He says God is never mentioned without His Prophet also being mentioned.
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r9.anchor: عن الحسن في قوله: {ورفعنا لك ذكرك} قال: ألا ترى أن الله لا يذكر في موضع إلا ذكر معه نبيه

DURR-FULL:v8p548/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r10.speaker: الحسن
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r10.claim: He also says that when God is mentioned, His Messenger is mentioned with Him.
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r10.anchor: عن الحسن {ورفعنا لك ذكرك} قال: إذا ذكر الله ذكر رسوله

DURR-FULL:v8p548/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r11.speaker: جبريل
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r11.claim: Gabriel tells the Prophet that God asks whether he knows how his renown was raised; the Prophet replies that God knows best.
DURR-FULL:v8p548/r11.anchor: عن أبي سعيد الخدري عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: أتاني جبريل فقال: إن ربك يقول: تدري كيف رفعت ذكرك

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.claim: In ما أنت إلا سيرا and similar phrases, the accusative verbal noun stands for an omitted verb: ما أنت إلا تفعل فعلا; the construction also occurs in questions and statements.

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.claim: شرب الإبل is not treated as an action the subject performs upon camels, so it is not made a nunated verbal noun in this construction.
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.anchor: فلا ينون لأنك لم تشبهه بشرب الإبل

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.claim: In إنما أنت سير, سير is a predicate of أنت with no implied verb; raising the following verbal noun can likewise make it identify the subject with the action.
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.anchor: وأما قولك إنما أنت سير فإنما

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.claim: Raising the action noun can equate subject and predicate, as in Khansa's إقبال وإدبار and the comparison نهارك صائم وليلك قائم; accusative remains possible with an omitted action verb.
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.anchor: فجاز على سعة الكلام كقولك نهارك صائم

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.claim: Interrogative verbal nouns such as أقياما describe the state at the time of speaking, not completed or future action; أطرَبا means أتطرب in that state.
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.anchor: وأما ما ينتصب فى الاستفهام من هذا الباب فقولك أقياما

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.claim: Other interrogative examples omit a verb: أغدة وموتا mean أأغد وأموت, while أعبدا may be vocative or may omit أتفتخر.
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.anchor: ومن ذلك قول بعض العرب أغدة كغدة البعير

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.claim: Jarir's question ألم تعلم مسيري فإتعابا وطردا is analyzed through omitted action verbs; the same accusative pattern works declaratively when context presents someone as acting now.

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.claim: The construction asserts an ongoing action at the time of mention; سماع الله puts the speaker in the state of listening, as if the action were seen.
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكماأنتإلاسيراوإلاسيراسير.anchor: أعوذ بحقو خالك يا ابن عمرو

NASHR:v2p97/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p97/r1.speaker: مكي
NASHR:v2p97/r1.claim: Makkī and several authorities use emphatic rāʾ in وزرك and ذكرك to match the verse endings.
NASHR:v2p97/r1.anchor: وزرك، ذكرك. في ألم نشرح فخمها مكي، وصاحب التجريد، والمهدوي وابن سفيان

NASHR:v2p97/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p97/r2.speaker: الآخرون
NASHR:v2p97/r2.claim: Other authorities lighten the rāʾ in وزرك and ذكرك according to the regular rule.
NASHR:v2p97/r2.anchor: ورققها الآخرون على القياس. والوجهان في التذكرة والتلخيصين، والكافي.

NASHR:v2p97/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p97/r3.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p97/r3.claim: Several works allow both forms and call emphatic rāʾ more common; al-Dānī read emphasis with Abū al-Fatḥ but chose the light reading.
NASHR:v2p97/r3.anchor: وقال: إن التفخيم فيهما أكثر. وحكى الوجهين في جامع البيان، وقال: إنه قرأ

ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r1.claim: God raised the Prophet's mention by joining it with His own in the testimony of faith, call to prayer, iqāmah, tashahhud, sermons, Qurʾān, titles, earlier scriptures, and the covenant with prophets and their peoples to believe in him.
ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r1.anchor: هو أن قرنه بذكره تعالى في كلمة الشهادة والأذان

ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r2.speaker: حسان
ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r2.claim: Ḥassān's poem says God joined the Prophet's name to His in the muezzin's testimony at each of the five daily prayers.
ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r2.anchor: وقال حسان : أغر عليه للنبوة خاتم

ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r3.claim: Listing these blessings implies that God will also grant victory over the Prophet's enemies.
ABUHAYYAN:94:4/r3.anchor: وتعديد هذه النعم عليه صلى الله عليه وسلم يقتضي

ALUSI:94:4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:4/r1.claim: God elevated the Prophet's remembrance through prophethood and many other ways: his name paired with God's in the testimony, obedience to him paired with obedience to God, blessings on him, honored divine forms of address, and mention in earlier scriptures and covenants.
ALUSI:94:4/r1.anchor: بالنبوة وغيرها وأي رفع مثل أن قرن اسمه عليه الصلاة والسلام باسمه عز وجل في كلمتي الشهادة

ALUSI:94:4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:4/r2.speaker: مجاهد وقتادة ومحمد بن كعب والضحاك والحسن
ALUSI:94:4/r2.claim: Mujahid, Qatada, Muhammad ibn Kab, al-Dahhak, al-Hasan, and others explain that the Prophet is never mentioned without being mentioned alongside God.
ALUSI:94:4/r2.anchor: وروي عن مجاهد وقتادة ومحمد بن كعب والضحاك والحسن وغيرهم أنهم قالوا في ذلك لا أذكر إلا ذكرت معي

ALUSI:94:4/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:4/r3.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري
ALUSI:94:4/r3.claim: Abu Said al-Khudri reports a Prophetic account: Gabriel conveyed God's question about the raised remembrance; God answered that whenever He is mentioned, the Prophet is mentioned with Him. No grading is given.
ALUSI:94:4/r3.anchor: عن أبي سعيد الخدري عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال

ALUSI:94:4/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:4/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:4/r4.claim: The report's focus on mention alongside God selects the greatest instance among the many ways remembrance was raised; Hassan's verses illustrate the pairing in the call to prayer.
ALUSI:94:4/r4.anchor: وكان ذلك من الاقتصار على ما هو أعظم قدراً من أفراد رفع الذكر

ALUSI:94:4/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:4/r5.speaker: حسان
ALUSI:94:4/r5.claim: Hassan's cited poetry says God joined the Prophet's name to His own, so the caller testifies to both at each of the five prayers.
ALUSI:94:4/r5.anchor: وضم الاله اسم النبي إلى اسمه إذا قال في الخمس المؤذن أشهد

ALUSI:94:4/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:4/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:4/r6.claim: Al-Ālūsī notes the subtle sequence of raising remembrance after placing the burden, along with the conjunction and the added لك, discussed as before.
ALUSI:94:4/r6.anchor: ولا يخفى لطف ذكر الرفع بعد الوضع والكلام في العطف وزيادة لك كالذي سلف

BAGHAWI:94:4/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:4/r1.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري عن النبي
BAGHAWI:94:4/r1.claim: The Prophet asked Gabriel about the verse, and Gabriel relayed God's answer: whenever the Prophet is mentioned, God is mentioned with him.
BAGHAWI:94:4/r1.anchor: عن أبي سعيد الخدري " عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه سأل جبريل عليه السلام عن هذه الآية { ورفعنا لك ذكرك } قال الله تعالى

BAGHAWI:94:4/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:4/r2.speaker: الحسن
BAGHAWI:94:4/r2.claim: Al-Hasan explains the raised remembrance as the Prophet being mentioned whenever God is mentioned.
BAGHAWI:94:4/r2.anchor: وعن الحسن قال : { ورفعنا لك ذكرك } إذا ذكرت ذكرت معي

BAGHAWI:94:4/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:4/r3.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
BAGHAWI:94:4/r3.claim: ʿAta, reporting Ibn Abbas, says the raised remembrance appears in the call to prayer, its commencement, the tashahhud, and sermons from pulpits.
BAGHAWI:94:4/r3.anchor: وقال عطاء عن ابن عباس : يريد الأذان والإقامة والتشهد والخطبة على المنابر

BAGHAWI:94:4/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:4/r4.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
BAGHAWI:94:4/r4.claim: The same report says a person who worships God and affirms everything but does not testify that Muhammad is God's messenger gains nothing and is an unbeliever.
BAGHAWI:94:4/r4.anchor: وقال عطاء عن ابن عباس : يريد الأذان والإقامة والتشهد والخطبة على المنابر ، ولو أن عبداً عبد الله وصدقه في كل شيء ولم يشهد

BAGHAWI:94:4/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:4/r5.speaker: قتادة
BAGHAWI:94:4/r5.claim: Qatada says God raised the Prophet's remembrance in this world and the next: preachers, witnesses, and worshippers proclaim the two testimonies.
BAGHAWI:94:4/r5.anchor: وقال قتادة : رفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والآخرة ، فليس خطيب ولا متشهد ولا صاحب صلاة

BAGHAWI:94:4/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:4/r6.speaker: الضحاك
BAGHAWI:94:4/r6.claim: Al-Dahhak says prayer is not accepted and a sermon is not valid without the Prophet's name.
BAGHAWI:94:4/r6.anchor: وقال الضحاك : لا تقبل صلاة إلا به ولا تجوز خطبة إلا به

BAGHAWI:94:4/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:4/r7.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI:94:4/r7.claim: Mujahid says the raised remembrance means the call to prayer.

BAGHAWI:94:4/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:4/r8.speaker: حسان بن ثابت
BAGHAWI:94:4/r8.claim: Hassan ibn Thabit's poem says God joins the Prophet's name with His in the five daily testimonies and derives Muhammad's name from His own name, Mahmud, to honor him.
BAGHAWI:94:4/r8.anchor: وضم الإله اسم النبي مع اسمه*** إذ قال في الخمس أشهد

BAGHAWI:94:4/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:4/r9.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:94:4/r9.claim: Another view says God raised the Prophet's mention by taking a covenant from the prophets and requiring them to believe in him and acknowledge his merit.
BAGHAWI:94:4/r9.anchor: وقيل : رفع الله ذكره بأخذ ميثاقه على النبيين وإلزامهم الإيمان به والإقرار بفضله

BAYDAWI:94:4/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:94:4/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:94:4/r1.claim: God elevated the Prophet through prophethood and more: linking his name to God's in the testimony, equating obedience to him with obedience to God, blessing him, commanding believers to pray for him, and addressing him with honorifics.
BAYDAWI:94:4/r1.anchor: ورفعنا لك ذكرك بالنبوة وغيرها وأي رفع مثل أن قرن اسمه باسمه تعالى في كلمتي الشهادة ، وجعل طاعته طاعته ،

BAYDAWI:94:4/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:94:4/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:94:4/r2.claim: The added laka creates an initial ambiguity followed by clarification, intensifying the statement.
BAYDAWI:94:4/r2.anchor: وإنما زاد لك ليكون إبهاما قبل إيضاح فيفيد المبالغة

BIQAI:94:4/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:4/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:4/r1.claim: God first perfected the Prophet inwardly, then raised his standing among all rational and nonrational beings so greatly that others’ renown pales beside it.
BIQAI:94:4/r1.anchor: ولما شرفه في نفسه بالكمال الجامع للجلال إلى الجلال ، وكان ذلك لا يصفو إلا مع الشرف عند الناس قال

BIQAI:94:4/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:4/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:4/r2.claim: Before prophethood, his people already knew him as al-Amīn and cited his pure character and radiant qualities as exemplary.
BIQAI:94:4/r2.anchor: حتى ما كانت شهرتك عند قومك قبل النبوة إلا الأمين ، وكانوا يضربون المثل بشمائلك الطاهرة

BIQAI:94:4/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:4/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:4/r3.claim: His honor increased successively through prophethood, messengership, and migration.
BIQAI:94:4/r3.anchor: ثم بالنبوة ثم بالرسالة ثم بالهجرة

BIQAI:94:4/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:4/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:4/r4.claim: God joined the Prophet’s name to His own in the declaration of faith and in worship’s public formulas, so the two are never mentioned separately there.
BIQAI:94:4/r4.anchor: وبأن جعلنا اسمك مقروناً باسمنا في كلمة التوحيد والإيمان والأذان والإقامة والتشهد والخطبة

BIQAI:94:4/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:4/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:4/r5.claim: Further honors include victory over his enemies, dignity for his allies, equating his approval and obedience with God’s, and ordering angels to bless him.
BIQAI:94:4/r5.anchor: ومن الكرامة الظفر على أعدائك والكرامة لأوليائك ، وجعل رضاك رضاي وطاعتك طاعتي

BIQAI:94:4/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:4/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:4/r6.claim: God further honors him by directing angels to bless him and addressing him with exalted titles such as Messenger and Prophet.
BIQAI:94:4/r6.anchor: وأمر ملائكتي بالصلاة عليك ، ومخاطبتي لك بالألقاب العلية والسمات المعزة المعلية من الرسول والنبي

BIQAI:94:4/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:4/r7.speaker: الرازي
BIQAI:94:4/r7.claim: Al-Razi says the Prophet’s community receives the fullest share of this honor and renown.
BIQAI:94:4/r7.anchor: قال الرازي : ثم جعل لأمته من ذلك أوفر الحظ

BIQAI:94:4/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:4/r8.speaker: رسول الله
BIQAI:94:4/r8.claim: A prophetic report identifies God’s allies as those whose mention, or whose sight in another version, brings God to mind; it adds that the best people recall God, increase knowledge, and encourage detachment from worldly life.
BIQAI:94:4/r8.anchor: يا رسول الله ، من أولياء الله ؟ قال :  "  الذين إذا ذُكروا ذُكر الله  "  وفي حديث :  "  الذين إذا رُؤُوا ذُكر الله  "

DURR:94:4/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:4/r1.speaker: مجاهد
DURR:94:4/r1.claim: Mujahid explains that the Prophet is mentioned alongside God in the testimony: there is no mention of God without mention of Muhammad.
DURR:94:4/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله : { ورفعنا لك ذكرك } قال : لا أذكر إلا ذكرت معي أشهد أن لا إله

DURR:94:4/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:4/r2.speaker: قتادة
DURR:94:4/r2.claim: Qatada says God raised the Prophet's remembrance in this world and the next: preachers, witnesses, and people praying all testify to both God and Muhammad.
DURR:94:4/r2.anchor: عن قتادة { ورفعنا لك ذكرك } قال : رفع الله ذكره في الدنيا والآخرة ، فليس خطيب ولا متشهد

DURR:94:4/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:4/r3.speaker: محمد بن كعب
DURR:94:4/r3.claim: Muhammad ibn Ka'b says whenever God is mentioned, the testimony mentions Muhammad with Him.
DURR:94:4/r3.anchor: عن محمد بن كعب في الآية قال : إذا ذكر الله ذكر معه أشهد أن لا إله

DURR:94:4/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:4/r4.speaker: الضحاك
DURR:94:4/r4.claim: Al-Dahhak says Muhammad is mentioned with God, and neither a sermon nor a marriage contract proceeds without mentioning him.
DURR:94:4/r4.anchor: عن الضحاك { ورفعنا لك ذكرك } قال : إذا ذكرت ذكرت معي ولا تجوز خطبة ولا نكاح

DURR:94:4/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
